scope: Location selection, menu navigation position, and repeated basket-mutation safeguards. This report does not establish a complete new two-provider comparison.

changes.result: GPS text is resolved against the selected city's canonical directory. A missing or ambiguous district explains why saving is unavailable and offers available districts. GPS retries directory loading even when the city is unchanged; equivalent city spelling preserves its loaded districts.

Accepts literal parentheses in source-provided city/district names. The observed compound district الحمراء-وأم-الجود(الزايدي) can be suggested for أم الجود, without automatically choosing a broader district or deriving a new URL from GPS text.
changes.remaining_rejections: Slash, backslash, percent-encoded path input, query, fragment, and traversal text remain rejected.

changes.result: The menu now has a direct change-location action. The vertical list resets to the top when entering/leaving a menu or changing restaurant; updates to the same menu preserve the user's scroll position.

Known restaurant identity now uses the same conservative normalization as the request fingerprint. Formatting aliases cannot permit a second first-Add. Unresolved legacy keys remain blocking until a matching complete basket observation can migrate them; they are not silently deleted.
changes.limits: This does not prove an unseen basket is empty and does not implement foreign-cart replacement.

changes.result: After suspending journal persistence, the navigator rechecks the active ownership frame, coroutine cancellation, and session before dispatching the one allowed mutation.
changes.limits: Source guard and regression checks are not a new live repeated-Compare test.

new_cases: Same-city GPS recovers after an initial district-directory failure and saves the selected canonical district.

isolated_emulator.fixture_setup_fix: The fixture clears the public controller, while saving an already persisted area is a no-op. Explicit fixture configuration now restores the controller before GPS assertions; no arbitrary sleep is used.
